result.markdown:
# Call setup failures and dropped sessions at S-SAH-010 caused by parameter optimisation batch OPT-21

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-SAH-010`
- **Confidence:** medium (Changes directly coincide with KPI degradation and their rollbacks match the exact recovery time across all affected nodes.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-30 06:15 to 2026-09-30 13:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-30 06:26
- **Affected:** S-SAH-010, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-009

## Summary

Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was applied to S-SAH-010, S-SAH-003, and S-SAH-009, degrading RRC success rates and increasing drop rates until rolled back.

RRC success drops and drop rate spikes occurred on three sites sharing microwave link LNK-SAH-02-B.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-30 05:14: Warning alarm DOOR_OPEN raised on S-SAH-002 and cleared at 05:24. [ALM-000538]
- 2026-09-30 06:15: Earliest onset of RRC success rate drop across affected sites. [T1, T3, ALR-0039]
- 2026-09-30 06:26: Config push CHG-2026-0080, CHG-2026-0081, and CHG-2026-0082 of OPT-21 applied. [CHG-2026-0080, CHG-2026-0081, CHG-2026-0082]
- 2026-09-30 06:49: Minor RRC failure rate high alarm raised on S-SAH-003. [ALM-000541]
- 2026-09-30 07:06: Minor RRC failure rate high alarm raised on S-SAH-010. [ALM-000543]
- 2026-09-30 13:39: Rollback of OPT-21 initiated on S-SAH-009. [CHG-2026-0083]
- 2026-09-30 13:40: Rollback of OPT-21 initiated on S-SAH-003 and S-SAH-010. [CHG-2026-0084, CHG-2026-0085]
- 2026-09-30 13:45: KPI recovery observed across all affected series. [T3]

## Evidence

- S-SAH-010, S-SAH-003, and S-SAH-009 experienced RRC success rate drops and drop rate spikes starting at 2026-09-30 06:15. [T1, T3, ALR-0039]
- Scheduled parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was applied to S-SAH-003, S-SAH-009, and S-SAH-010 at 2026-09-30 06:26. [CHG-2026-0080, CHG-2026-0081, CHG-2026-0082]
- Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was rolled back on S-SAH-009, S-SAH-003, and S-SAH-010 between 13:39 and 13:40 after NOC escalation. [CHG-2026-0083, CHG-2026-0084, CHG-2026-0085]
- All affected KPI series fully recovered at 2026-09-30 13:45 following the configuration rollbacks. [T3]
- No critical or major alarms were present during the incident window across the checked nodes. [T4]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-SAH-010: confirmed. Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was applied right before KPI degradation and rolling it back restored normal KPI levels. [CHG-2026-0080, CHG-2026-0081, CHG-2026-0082, CHG-2026-0083, CHG-2026-0084, CHG-2026-0085, T3]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SAH-02-B: rejected. No critical or major transport alarms were found, and changes perfectly coincide with the failure and recovery times. [T4, CHG-2026-0080, T3]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000538: Warning DOOR_OPEN alarm on S-SAH-002 cleared before the incident onset and occurred on an unrelated node.

## Recommended actions

- Review parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 configurations before any future deployments to prevent regression.
- Verify pre-check procedures for automated configuration batches on rural and urban site clusters.

- `ALM-000538`: warning DOOR_OPEN on S-SAH-002, raised 2026-09-30 05:14, cleared 2026-09-30 05:24
- `T1`: get_anomalies(start=2026-09-30 04:00, end=2026-10-01 08:51, entity_id=S-SAH-010) -> 1 alert(s): ALR-0039 2026-09-30 06:15-13:45. RRC success drops; drop rate spikes on 3 sites in SAH (S-SAH-003, S-SAH-009, S-SAH-010) for 7.5 h

- `ALR-0039`: ended alert from 2026-09-30 06:15: 3 site(s) (S-SAH-003, S-SAH-009, S-SAH-010); region-level SAH; metrics: drop_rate_pct, rrc_success_pct
